 (d) SE of an exceedance proportion at the bar: sqrt(0.05 x 0.95 / 300) = 0.0126 per subsample (PC1's form).
 (e) MDE80 = 2.80 x 0.0126 = 0.0352 per subsample; the 4-of-5 rule is reachable with 80% power when each subsample's true exceedance probability is below about 0.015 (then P(X <= 14 of 300) near 1 per subsample) and fails reliably above about 0.085.
 (f) VERDICT LINE: PS1 SCOREABLE as a classification (CERTIFIED and NOT-CERTIFIED both observable at 5 subsamples); at the prediction (declared statistic about 0.11 against a null p95 about 0.07 at n about 486, a pilot guess) CERTIFIED is the modal branch, but the null's width at n 486 is unmeasured, so the line is re-stated at the run.
 (g) STRUCTURAL LEG: reachable at 300 reps (the floor 1/301 is far below 0.05); at very small n the splitter's null may be NULL-INFEASIBLE (n < 2 x mcs = 110: not at these sizes) or DEGENERATE (< 20 replicates reach the gate): such a subsample is NOT EVALUABLE (stated now).
PREDICTIONS (probabilities by Brier; the null width at n about 486 is not measured on the record: priors weak). P1 PS1 CERTIFIED-AT-SIZE 0.55, MIXED 0.20, NOT-CERTIFIED-AT-SIZE 0.25. P2 PS2 CERTIFIED-AT-SIZE 0.50. P3 the n 486 subsamples' median declared statistic 0.11 [0.09, 0.14]; null p95 0.07 [0.05, 0.10]. P4 C0 comparable on every subsample 0.85.
FALSIFIER. F-PS fires iff PS1 reads NOT-CERTIFIED-AT-SIZE: the certificate cannot certify the declared level at G12's depth-1 site sizes, so G12's 0 of 60 at depth 1 IS read as a sensitivity limit at those sizes (CERTIFIED-POSITIVE-CONTROL's root-scale result stands). If PS1 reads CERTIFIED-AT-SIZE, N-1's empty set reads "the tree's data-driven depth-1 splits are less separated than the declared level at the same n" (with the k and population caveats above). F-TAX N-1 and F2 stand either way.
WHAT THIS RESULT WILL NOT SHOW (fixed before data). A certificate of any tree site; power for 2-3-way splits (k not matched) or within one anchor (population not matched); other members, draws, slices or recipes; that the categories are geometric clusters; a mode test (MIX-LRT-SITE closed).
COST AND CONSEQUENCE. 0 calls, 0 cce, no construction. Machine: 3 sizes x 5 subsamples x (300-rep null + 300 relabellings) at n <= 486 (about 35 min per size, the schedule's estimate), rule-7 windows. Agent time: engine-coder (subsample flags on certPositiveControl, about 1.5 h), reviewer READY, run-operator, post-run review, registrar. Consequence: the reading of G12 / N-1 at depth-1 sizes in SQ3.

## Registrar's record 2026-10-03 (insertion only; zero calls; nothing run; pre-data) — CERT-PC-SIZE built (branch cert-pc-size 88bbf560; cert_pc_size.py de39c648): Q-1 the NOT EVALUABLE gate is read first (CR-3 precedence); Q-2 a DEGENERATE subsample counts toward that gate
[SECTION SPAN L23767-L23772; _as_of the commit that writes it, parent 484b9129, re-grepped]
WHO. The builder's two readings (relayed by the orchestrator), ruled by the registrar pre-data; no arm has run.
Q-1 (overlap). As registered, 2 or more C0 failures together with at most 1 certified subsample satisfy both "NOT EVALUABLE" and "NOT-CERTIFIED-AT-SIZE". RULING: the NOT EVALUABLE gate is read FIRST and decides (CERT-POSITIVE-CONTROL's CR-3: a failing C0 precondition takes precedence over a verdict). Moves no criterion: NOT EVALUABLE is a precondition on the evaluable subsamples, not a second verdict over the same statistic, and every count (certified / uncertified / C0-failed / degenerate) is printed beside, so the NOT-CERTIFIED reading stays visible.
Q-2 (degenerate subsamples). RULING: YES, a DEGENERATE subsample (fewer than 20 of its 300 null replicates reach the gate) counts toward the >= 2 gate, with a C0 failure. Reason: Support (g) of the registration already classes it NOT EVALUABLE ("a collapsed null certifies nothing"), the same status as a C0 failure; the gate exists so that the 4-of-5 / at-most-1-of-5 rule is never applied to fewer than 4 evaluable subsamples; counting only C0 failures would let two degenerate subsamples turn a size into MIXED or NOT-CERTIFIED on 3 evaluable ones. The builder's implementation matches.
STATE. CERT-PC-SIZE: registered -> built (branch cert-pc-size 88bbf560, unmerged; READY needed). Bracket at PS1 (L23736); record, INDEX, queue in this commit; ledger unchanged. Bill: 0 calls.

For each held-out member m (6 replays): (1) CALIBRATION (nested leave-one-out on GATE): for each in-member j != m, score j's GATE items by max-cos to the cells of the other four in-members; tau_m = the smallest threshold at which the MEDIAN over the five j of the share of j's GATE items with max-cos < tau is >= 0.80 (TARGET CATCH RATE 0.80). (2) STREAM: the five in-members' cells with FROZEN means (no update, ever; their ids and directions are fixed); m's TRAIN then EVAL in stage 1's order (numpy default_rng(20261003), fresh per replay). An item is BUFFERED iff its max-cos to the five-member cells is < tau_m (strict); otherwise it is filed by flatLeaf. Every 100 buffered items the buffer cells are refit from scratch by g13_breakdown.ukm_fit (seed 0, k = min(L_m, buffer size)); buffer cells are provisional and their ids are NOT stable. (3) FILING of each EVAL item at arrival: flatLeaf over the five-member cells plus the buffer cells of the last rebuild. Naming: OL-R5 unchanged (TRAIN majority; incumbent keeps a tie; EVAL labels never name a cell). BATCH arm: OL-R1 unchanged (flatLeaf over all six members' cells; IFEVAL one-cell). K-MEANS arm: the same procedure from per-source k-means at K_0 against batch per-source k-means. INTEGRITY CHECK (not a criterion; it cannot fail by design): the in-members' EVAL addresses before and after each replay must be identical (churn exactly 0); any nonzero churn makes the run INVALID. INSTRUMENT. tools/analysis/drift_replay.py, TO BE BUILT, importing union_af_route.py (blob bf3f17db) and g13_breakdown.py (c29fa1c3; ukm_fit) unchanged. STREAMS (numpy default_rng(20261005), one child per stream): 1,000 items drawn with replacement; items 1-500 from the reference mix pi_0 (EVAL's own source shares), items 501-1,000 from pi_1 = (1 - s) pi_0 + s e_m, a shift of size s toward member m; s in {0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.40} x the six members, R 200 streams per (s, m) (4,800 shifted streams); s = 0: 1,200 unshifted streams; within a source, items uniform. INTERVAL: bootstrap B 2,000 (default_rng(20261007)) over streams within (s, m) strata, the six members FIXED strata (the claim is about these six directions, not a sampled population of shifts), the five k-means seeds resampled independently and crossed with the streams (the SCALE-AGREE D-1 lesson); conditional on this EVAL set; a component-level bootstrap at s 0.20 only (B 200) printed beside for item reuse. NODE RULES. (1) KAPPA-SKM (control): for k = 2..8, spherical k-means (n_init 5, seed s); k admissible iff every child has >= m_min TRAIN items (m_min copied by the builder from S1's M-AF / C-AF TOMLs and printed) AND the minimum pairwise child separation (1 - cos of child mean directions) >= 0.025 (the qwen3-256 bar of the intent and re-draw builds); among admissible k, the k maximising the size-weighted mean Banerjee kappa of the children; none admissible -> not split by the rule. (2) BISECT-SKM: spherical 2-means (n_init 5, seed s) at every split. (3) GMM-BIC: diagonal-covariance Gaussian mixture on the node's 256-d slice (reg_covar 1e-6, n_init 3, seed s), k in 1..8 by minimum BIC; k = 1 -> not split by the rule. (4) WARD: Ward linkage (Euclidean on the renormalised slice) on all TRAIN items, read top-down: the top L - 1 merges give L leaves (binary; deterministic, seed-free; the matched element is L, not the multiway shape; disclosed). (5) HDBSCAN (DESCRIPTIVE ONLY): sklearn HDBSCAN(min_cluster_size = m_min) on TRAIN, its condensed tree as the hierarchy, its own leaf count plus ONE noise leaf; never in the deciding criterion. FILING (every arm): EVAL items to the nearest leaf centroid (renormalised mean of the leaf's TRAIN members at the slice; flatLeaf; HDBSCAN's noise leaf has no centroid). READOUTS AND CRITERIA. Per arm j in {2, 3, 4}, readout r in {(a), (c)}, corpus in {MASSIVE, CLINC}: D_jr = mean over arm j's seeds minus mean over arm 1's seeds of the readout; spread_1r = the range of arm 1's five seed values of r on that corpus. (a) DP_coarse: dendrogram purity of the arm's hierarchy on filed EVAL items against the coarse gold level (S1.dendrogram_purity unchanged); each arm x seed also against its own 200 matched-shape random trees (GR2 instrument, p97.5, descriptive). (c) LEAF FILING ACCURACY (fine): share of EVAL items whose fine gold label equals the majority TRAIN fine gold label of the leaf they are filed to (ties to the smallest label id). INTERVAL (crossed and paired): percentile bootstrap, B 2,000, numpy default_rng(20261006); per replicate the EVAL CK-CLOSE components are resampled once and shared by all arms (paired over items) and arm j's and arm 1's five seeds are resampled independently with replacement (crossed; seed s of two arms shares nothing; WARD has one deterministic fit). C-CA (THE ONE DECIDING CRITERION; the POINT AND the INTERVAL jointly, in this one clause): ARM-WINS iff there is at least one pair (j, r) such that on BOTH MASSIVE and CLINC D_jr > spread_1r AND the 95% lower bound of D_jr > 0 (the winning (j, r) pairs are named); NO-ARM-WINS otherwise. The two words are exhaustive and cannot fire together. FAILS (rule 8): ARM-WINS is refuted at the planned n if for every (j, r) at least one corpus has D_jr <= spread_1r or a lower bound <= 0 (e.g. bisecting's DP_coarse lead on CLINC inside arm 1's seed range); NO-ARM-WINS is refuted by one (j, r) clearing both conjuncts on both corpora. MULTIPLICITY: six (j, r) chances, each needing four conditions on two corpora; under the global null with independent corpora the one-sided false-win rate is <= 6 x 0.025^2 = 0.004 before the spread conjunct; no further correction. DESCRIPTIVE (all of the rest): ARM-1-AHEAD per (j, r, corpus) iff D_jr < -spread_1r AND the 95% upper bound < 0; (b) seed-pair triplet disagreement per arm (10 seed pairs; 100,000 triplets on TRAIN, numpy RandomState(20261004); on C site_support's sample of record), printed in BOTH conventions, all triplets and resolved-in-both, with each arm's unresolved share beside (the STABILITY-VS-KMEANS B-1 lesson), and, for every arm including WARD and HDBSCAN, a 90%-TRAIN-subsample stability (subsample seeds 0-4) so the seed-free arms are compared like with like; (d) CLINC OOS AUROC per arm (oos_tree_cells' score: max-cos to the arm's leaf centroids; in-scope EVAL 6,672 vs oos_plus 1,350) with D vs arm 1 and its paired stratified component bootstrap; the MMLU-Pro C leg (DP against the category, in-sample on C, and (b)); HDBSCAN on every readout with its noise share; the engine reference rows; forced-split counts; leaf-size distributions. [SECTION SPAN L24814-L24826; _as_of the commit that writes it, parent 4c764a1e, re-grepped]
QUESTION AND KIND. Zero-call CPU readout. Every union routing number of record uses the tree's LEAVES only (flatLeaf filing; G14's policy: argmax per cell over the sorted roster, a cell with TRAIN mass < 1 backs off to the best single; union_route_common.py docstring). The hierarchy enters no decision. Here it enters one: each leaf's per-model accuracy is shrunk toward its parent's, recursively, so thin leaves borrow from their ancestors. A gain over flat-leaf is a value of the hierarchy for routing; the k-means arm (flat clusters with a Ward-on-centroids hierarchy within source) asks whether any hierarchy over cells does as well.

HIERARCHIES. AF-U: each leaf's parent chain inside its source tree as built, up to the source root, then the union root. K-WARD: per source and seed, Ward linkage (Euclidean) on K_s's renormalised TRAIN leaf centroids at the slice K_s was fitted on (the CONSTRUCTION-ARMS F1 procedure), then source root, then union root. SHRINKAGE (empirical Bayes, beta-binomial, one common strength per arm): top-down, p_root,m = model m's TRAIN accuracy over all TRAIN items; for node v with TRAIN count n_v and correct count s_v,m, p_v,m = (s_v,m + tau x p_parent(v),m) / (n_v + tau); the leaf policy picks argmax_m p_leaf,m (ties by the sorted roster, as V.fit). tau on the grid {0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000}, chosen per arm (per seed for K-WARD) as the GATE routed-accuracy maximiser, ties to the smaller tau; tau = 0 IS the flat-leaf policy (with V.fit's mass < 1 back-off). ARMS. TF tree flat (UNION-AF-ROUTE U1, existing); TB tree back-off; KF k-means flat (existing K_s); KB k-means back-off; SRC source-only (best TRAIN model per source, ROUTE-SOURCE-NULL); BEST best single. ## Registered 2026-10-08 (before any code or call) — SATURATION-IRT: relative to these 18 models, how saturated is each of the six union benchmarks under Rasch and 2PL item response models, and does the top 10% most discriminating items per benchmark (chosen without the ranked model's own responses) keep Kendall tau >= 0.90 of the full macro ranking? QUESTION AND KIND. Zero-call CPU readout, no construction, no judge. Post 1 ("MMLU-Pro is full, GPQA isn't"). GPQA-HEADROOM's top-4 all-correct shares (7.2% GPQA, 36.7% MMLU-Pro) and pairwise-differ shares are KNOWN, so SI2 is confirmatory of a seen pattern and is scored but not credited as blind; no IRT fit, discrimination estimate or subset ranking has been computed on these data.
DATA OBJECTS AND HYGIENE. The union correctness matrix of the 18-model roster (G14 reader, eval_view keyed correctness; Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct excluded), all six sources (MMLU_PRO_LB, BBH, MATH, MUSR, GPQA, IFEVAL), every item of every split side (no fit / test split is needed: nothing is trained on items to predict items; the selection is de-circularised by leave-one-model-out instead), after R1 (471 twins dropped, exact duplicates collapsed) and R2 (one extractor per harness). Planning size: about 21,000 items (21,606 less the 471 and the collapsed duplicates; printed per source). Clusters: CK-CLOSE-v1 stem_key components (split_side.stem_key). A POOL READER under rule 7 only through the reader's DB opens (mode=ro&immutable=1; busy.ps1 exit 1 before --run). INSTRUMENT. tools/analysis/saturation_irt.py, TO BE BUILT. Per benchmark, two models fitted by penalised joint maximum likelihood (18 respondents = models, items = items): RASCH logit p_mi = theta_m - b_i and 2PL logit p_mi = a_i (theta_m - b_i), priors b_i ~ N(0, 2^2), log a_i ~ N(0, 0.5^2), theta centred at 0; items solved by all or by none of the fitted models are excluded from the fit and counted (ALL / NONE). Item-parameter intervals: parametric bootstrap B 200 (responses simulated from the fitted 2PL, refitted; 95% percentile). LOMO SELECTION (deciding): for each model m, refit the 2PL on the other 17 models; per benchmark take the top 10% of items by posterior-mean a_i among items not constant over the 17 (ties by item id); score m by its accuracy on that subset; the macro score of m = the mean over the six benchmarks. FULL ranking = macro accuracy over all deduplicated items. Ranking statistic: Kendall tau-b between the LOMO-subset macro ranking and the full macro ranking (18 models, 153 pairs). In-sample selection (all 18 in the fit) is computed beside, DESCRIPTIVE (circular: its tau is an optimistic reading). Interval for tau: component bootstrap B 200 (CK-CLOSE components resampled within benchmark, the whole LOMO procedure repeated), default_rng(20261008), 95% percentile; its SD is the SE reported. Seeds and package versions printed.
READOUTS AND CRITERIA (the POINT decides SI1; the bootstrap interval is printed beside and decides nothing; each rule exhaustive and exclusive). SI1 (DECIDING): KEEPS-RANKING iff tau_LOMO >= 0.90; LOSES-RANKING iff tau_LOMO < 0.90. FAILS (rule 8): KEEPS-RANKING is refuted by tau_LOMO < 0.90, i.e. >= 8 discordant pairs of 153 at the planned n. SI2 (SCORED; CONFIRMATORY OF A SEEN PATTERN; the POINT decides): per benchmark the information share NEFF_b = the share of benchmark items whose 2PL Fisher information a_i^2 p(1 - p) at theta_top4 (the mean ability of the top 4 models by full macro accuracy) is >= 0.10, counting ALL / NONE items as 0; GPQA-OPEN iff NEFF_GPQA > NEFF_MMLU_PRO_LB; else NOT-SHOWN. FAILS: NEFF_GPQA <= NEFF_MMLU_PRO_LB. DESCRIPTIVE: ALL_b, NONE_b, SAT4_b (share solved by all of the top 4; GPQA-HEADROOM's metric on this roster) with Wilson intervals; Rasch vs 2PL penalised log-likelihood and the share of items with a 95% a-interval excluding 1; "how many items do you need" curves (tau_LOMO against subset share 5-50%, top-a vs random subsets, 20 random draws); the UpSet of which models solve the items solved by <= 3 models; tau_in-sample; macro vs micro ranking. INSTRUMENT. tools/analysis/win_map.py, TO BE BUILT, importing union_af_route.py (blob bf3f17db) and cell_flips.py (READY 998d39a7) unchanged for the reader, the frozen policies, the two-stage bootstrap and CELL-FLIPS' flip set. ORACLE-WATERFALL on EVAL: O_q = share of items solved by >= 1 model. O_adj (luck-adjusted; deciding baseline): chance c_i by item format (1 / the item's option count for MMLU-Pro, GPQA, MC tasks of BBH and MuSR; 0 for MATH, IFEval and free-form BBH tasks; items without a stored option count get 0 and are counted); know rate k_mc = max(0, (acc_mc - cbar_c) / (1 - cbar_c)) for model m in declared cell c from TRAIN (cbar_c the cell's mean chance); for a solver m of item i, q_mi = k_mc / (k_mc + (1 - k_mc) c_i); O_adj = mean over items of 1{solved} x (1 - prod over solvers (1 - q_mi)) (independence across models assumed and disclosed). O_chance = mean of 1 - (1 - c_i)^18 (18 chance-level guessers; descriptive). O_sim (descriptive): the oracle of 200 simulated rosters drawn from the fitted know / guess model (no item-specific structure). O_cell = per AF-U cell, the best model chosen ON EVAL (in-sample cell ceiling); declared-cell O_cell beside. R_AF = the frozen TRAIN AF-U policy's EVAL accuracy (asserted equal to UNION-AF-ROUTE's 0.6201 within 1e-4; refusal otherwise); B = the TRAIN-chosen best single model (asserted 0.6049). INTERVALS: UNION-AF-ROUTE's two-stage bootstrap (TRAIN policy refit x EVAL components), B 2,000, with O_adj, O_q and B recomputed per replicate; 95% percentile. REGION-STABILITY: UMAP (umap-learn, version pinned; cosine, n_neighbors 30, min_dist 0.1) seeds 0-4; Euclidean k-means k = 20 on the 2-D coordinates (k-means++, 10 restarts) seeds 0-4: 25 partitions; the PUBLISHED map = UMAP seed 0 x k-means seed 0. ARI between partitions; per-region best-match Jaccard.
READOUTS AND CRITERIA (each criterion names what decides; exhaustive and exclusive). WF1 (DECIDING, ORACLE-WATERFALL; the 95% INTERVAL decides): rho = (R_AF - B) / (O_adj - B). REALISATION-GAP iff the 95% upper bound of rho < 0.25 (the router realises under a quarter of the luck-adjusted headroom); NOT-SHOWN otherwise. FAILS (rule 8): an upper bound >= 0.25. WF2 (SCORED; the 95% INTERVAL decides): lambda = (O_q - O_adj) / (O_q - B), the share of the oracle headroom that is luck; LUCK-MATERIAL iff the 95% lower bound of lambda > 0.10; NOT-SHOWN otherwise. FAILS: a lower bound <= 0.10. RS1 (DECIDING, REGION-STABILITY; the POINT decides): STABLE-MAP iff the median ARI over the partition pairs that differ in UMAP seed (10 UMAP pairs x 25 k-means pairings) >= 0.80; UNSTABLE-MAP otherwise. FAILS: a median < 0.80. RS2 (CAPTION RULE, scored as a count; the POINT decides): a region of the published map is STABLE iff its median best-match Jaccard over the other 24 partitions >= 0.75; a winner caption ("model X wins here") is licensed iff the region is STABLE AND the same model is the EVAL argmax in >= 20 of the 25 matched regions AND winner minus B on the region's EVAL items is BH-surviving at q 0.05 over the stable regions (CELL-FLIPS' one-sided component-bootstrap form, B 10,000). Under UNSTABLE-MAP no region is captioned, whatever RS2 counts. DESCRIPTIVE: the waterfall in both raw (O_q) and luck-adjusted forms per source; O_chance, O_sim; rho_raw = (R_AF - B) / (O_q - B); declared-cell arms; ARI across k-means seeds at fixed UMAP seed; k = 10 and 40; ARI of k-means on the 512-d rows directly (no UMAP); the second-embedder map (nomic) only after the embedder gate EMBEDDER-PLUMBING, descriptive; entropy across models per region. Dose groups by a seeded partition: d = 0 (500 matches), 0.10 (500; 50 wrong), 0.25 (400; 100 wrong), 0.50 (400; 200 wrong): 350 planted-wrong and 1,450 right references per family. REFERENCE (answer-only, so no reasoning text is planted): "The correct final answer is: <X>", X = the key (right) or the WRONG contestant's extracted answer (planted wrong, aligned with the wrong side). TRAIN never read. GPQA not used. Outputs (caches, verdicts) NEVER committed; release = verdicts and ids only (R5).
INSTRUMENT. tools/analysis/judge_key_dose.py, TO BE BUILT. Families: A grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning (STACK-v2's judge), B Mistral-Large-3 (Azure deployment); STACK-v2's v1 prompt with the reference slot carrying the planted line; every call via rejudge_reasoning.call_judge_full, body via rr.payload_body; cap 8192; temperature OMITTED (plan Amendment 1 D2); dual order, TIE on a flip; write-once cache per family on E:; guard: estimate and ceiling printed every run; zero-call TRANSPORT PREFLIGHT inside the dry-run; pilot 12 read by the truncation guard (refuse > 5% unparsed). Control of record: the d = 0 group. Calls: 1,800 matches x 2 orders x 2 families = 7,200 (ceiling 7,500 with retries); 3,600 dual-order matches (< 4,000; under the 4k-match rule, and under the 14,000-call day cap on one posting day).
READOUTS AND CRITERIA (the INTERVAL decides; per family; exhaustive and exclusive). Score per match: 1 if the key-correct side wins, 0.5 TIE, 0 loss. Under independent calls the dose curve is linear in expectation, so the deciding slope is b = acc(wrong reference) - acc(right reference) (the change per unit dose); the four dose-group means are plotted with intervals and a linearity check is descriptive. KD1 (DECIDING, per family): KEY-FOLLOWED iff the 95% upper bound of b < 0; KEY-IGNORED iff the 90% interval of b lies inside [-0.05, +0.05] (TOST); NEITHER otherwise. FAILS (rule 8): KEY-FOLLOWED is refuted by an upper bound >= 0. The post's headline needs KEY-FOLLOWED in BOTH families (stated jointly as "<A word> / <B word>"). DESCRIPTIVE: acc_right, acc_wrong per family and source; family difference in b; the alluvial (reference right / wrong x answer right / wrong -> verdict); TIE shares; the dose curve.
SUPPORT. (a) DECIDING denominator per family: 350 planted-wrong and 1,450 right-reference matches (1,800 items, one match per item; CK-CLOSE components about 1,650, Kish about 1.09). (b) DEFF 2.727, TRANSPORTED from K46-KEY-READ's MEASURED C1 value (variants clustered by component there; conservative here, one match per item). (c) n_eff: wrong 350 / 2.727 = 128; right 1,450 / 2.727 = 532. (d) SE(b) = sqrt(2.727) x sqrt(0.26 x 0.74 / 350 + 0.93 x 0.07 / 1,450) = 1.651 x sqrt(0.000550 + 0.0000449) = 1.651 x 0.02439 = 0.0403. (e) MDE80 = 2.8 x 0.0403 = 0.113 against 0. (f) VERDICT LINE: KD1 SCOREABLE per family: the predicted b -0.62 lies 0.62 from 0, far beyond 0.113; KEY-IGNORED (TOST +/-0.05) is reachable only if acc_wrong is within 0.05 of acc_right. (g) STRUCTURAL: both words reachable at infinite budget; b is bounded by [-1, +1]; the planted reference agrees with the wrong side, the hardest case, so b here is an adversarial reading, not a natural-error rate.
PREDICTIONS (probabilities by Brier; numbers HELD iff the point lies in the band). P1 family A: acc_right 0.92 [0.88, 0.96]; acc_wrong 0.30 [0.15, 0.50]; b -0.62 [-0.80, -0.40]. P2 family B: b -0.55 [-0.80, -0.25]. P3 KD1 KEY-FOLLOWED in both families 0.85; KEY-IGNORED in either 0.05. P4 TIE share at wrong references 0.25 [0.10, 0.40] (family A).
FALSIFIER. F-KD fires iff KD1 reads KEY-IGNORED in either family: that judge's verdict does not follow a planted wrong reference. It overturns, for that family and this answer-only form, the reading of K46-KEY-READ's 0.2632 (n 38) that the judge follows the reference over the answer.
WHAT A NULL MEANS FOR THE POST. KEY-IGNORED: "judges ignore the key" is the headline, contradicting K46 and equally quotable (the plan's null form); NEITHER: the post reports the curve with its interval and no headline word.
WHAT THIS RESULT WILL NOT SHOW. Natural reference-error rates (planted, answer-only, adversarially aligned); reasoning-text references; other judges, prompts or recipes (never joined with STACK-v2's or the v2 recipe's numbers); SQ2's instrument (the author's, open); a fix (no gating or abstention is tested; those lines are closed); free-form or agentic tasks.

Prior results touched (results/ first): K46-KEY-READ (done; sizing, DEFF), TRACE-TRUNCATION (done; answer-only reference form), JUDGE-SOLVED-SPLIT (registered), ORACLE (done; [P-FAM], closed frontier line, not reopened). ## Registered 2026-10-08 (before any code or call) — JUDGE-RETEST-LENGTH: on content-closed key-decidable matches, how much of a pairwise judge's verdict instability is position beyond byte-identical test-retest noise (run R), and does neutral length change move the verdict once editing is controlled by a same-length paraphrase (run L)? (DESIGN ONLY; two judged runs; SPEND PENDING AUTHOR GO; HF post 6)
[SECTION SPAN L25112-L25125; _as_of the commit that writes it, parent e83b59d5, re-grepped]
QUESTION AND KIND. Judged design, registered so that its runs can start on the author's go; NO call is licensed by this registration. Post 6 ("Ask the judge twice"). Two runs, each under 4,000 matches and each needing its own go: R (test-retest in both orders) and L (pad / trim / paraphrase). The history (POSITION-DECOMP: flip 0.124, test-retest 0.057, position 0.067; DECOMP 5.7%; the +0.39/1k verbosity slope) is [P-FAM], motivation only; TRACE-TRUNCATION (content-closed checker reference; padding with spaces -0.131) is why the paraphrase control exists.
DATA ALREADY LOOKED AT (R3). The [P-FAM] position / noise split and TRACE-TRUNCATION's edit sensitivity are KNOWN and sized this design; nothing here has been judged.
DATA OBJECTS AND HYGIENE. Content-closed v2 union split EVAL (pool pv2_1575de61bb20e977), MATH and MMLU_PRO_LB key-decidable matches (one key-correct, one key-wrong response, both >= 600 characters so trimming is meaningful), 600 matches drawn at random.Random(20261009) among roster models whose raw responses G-RAW certifies (CONDITION as in JUDGE-KEY-DOSE), MATH share 20%; the SAME 600 matches in R and L and for both families. Reference: STACK-v2's form is not required; both runs use the answer-only key reference of JUDGE-KEY-DOSE's d = 0 arm ("The correct final answer is: <key>") so that only position, repetition and length vary. Outputs NEVER committed; release = verdicts and ids only.
INSTRUMENT. tools/analysis/judge_retest_length.py, TO BE BUILT; families A grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning and B Mistral-Large-3; JUDGE-KEY-DOSE's call path, cap, OMITTED temperature, write-once caches on E:, guard, transport preflight and pilot-12 truncation guard. RUN R: each match judged AB, AB', BA, BA' (byte-identical repeats, separate calls): 600 x 4 x 2 families = 4,800 calls; 2,400 dual-order judgements. r = the share of same-order repeat pairs whose verdicts differ (averaged over the two orders); f = the share of matches whose first-repeat dual-order verdict flips (AB vs BA). RUN L: on the same 600 matches, the edited side E is chosen at random (seeded; correct side in half); arms PAD (E + a fixed 1,000-character neutral filler paragraph, frozen in the script before READY, no content claim, no answer), TRIM (E cut to its final line, TRACE-TRUNCATION's operation), PARA (a same-length paraphrase of E, +/-5% characters, by gpt-4o-mini with temperature omitted, final answer verified unchanged by R2's extractor; up to 2 retries, else the match is dropped from L and counted). ORIG = run R's first repeat pair. Calls: 600 x 3 arms x 2 orders x 2 families = 7,200 judge calls + at most 1,800 paraphrase calls; 3,600 dual-order judgements. Score of E per match: 1 win, 0.5 TIE, 0 loss. Intervals: component bootstrap B 2,000 (CK-CLOSE components, both families resampled together), 95% percentile.
READOUTS AND CRITERIA (the INTERVAL decides every criterion; pooled over the two families; per-family values descriptive; exhaustive and exclusive). RL1 (DECIDING, run R): POSITION-SHOWN iff the 95% lower bound of f - r > 0; NOT-SHOWN otherwise. FAILS (rule 8): a lower bound <= 0. RL2 (DECIDING, run L): Delta_PAD = W_PAD - W_PARA (score of E). LENGTH-PAYS iff the 95% lower bound > 0; LENGTH-PENALISED iff the 95% upper bound < 0; NEITHER otherwise. FAILS: LENGTH-PAYS is refuted by a lower bound <= 0. DESCRIPTIVE: r and f per family; first-position win rate against second-position win rate per family (the scatter); Delta_TRIM = W_TRIM - W_PARA; Delta_edit = W_PARA - W_ORIG (editing alone; TRACE-TRUNCATION's confound); P(win) against the length gap; the "rank spaghetti" re-ranking under the measured noise (presentation, reads only these verdicts).
SUPPORT. (a) DECIDING denominators: 600 matches x 2 families = 1,200 pooled judgements per run (about 560 CK-CLOSE components, Kish about 1.09). (b) DEFF 1.45, a DECLARED PILOT ASSUMPTION: about 1.3 for the two families judging the same match (within-match correlation about 0.3) x 1.1 for components (no measured value for this design). (c) n_eff = 1,200 / 1.45 = 828. (d) SE: RL1 with d = flip_order - flip_retest per match, Var(d) about f + r - (f - r)^2 = 0.124 + 0.057 - 0.0045 = 0.1765 ([P-FAM] planning values): SE = sqrt(0.1765 x 1.45 / 1,200) = sqrt(0.000213) = 0.0146. RL2 with paired discordance 0.25: SE = sqrt(0.25 x 1.45 / 1,200) = sqrt(0.000302) = 0.0174. (e) MDE80: RL1 2.8 x 0.0146 = 0.041; RL2 2.8 x 0.0174 = 0.049. (f) VERDICT LINE: RL1 SCOREABLE (predicted f - r 0.05 lies 0.05 above 0, beyond 0.041; narrowly; at DEFF 2.0 the MDE is 0.048, still inside); RL2 DESCRIPTIVE-ONLY (predicted Delta_PAD +0.03, inside 0.049); doubling L to reach scoreability exceeds the 4k-match rule. (g) STRUCTURAL: both words reachable at infinite budget; f - r can be negative only by noise; Delta_PAD is identified against PARA, so an edit effect common to both arms cancels.
PREDICTIONS (probabilities by Brier; numbers HELD iff the point lies in the band). P1 r 0.05 [0.02, 0.09] (pooled); f 0.10 [0.05, 0.16]. P2 RL1 POSITION-SHOWN 0.70; f - r 0.05 [0.01, 0.09]. P3 family A favours the first position, family B the second (0.55). P4 RL2 LENGTH-PAYS 0.25, NEITHER 0.60, LENGTH-PENALISED 0.15; Delta_PAD +0.03 [-0.05, +0.11]. P5 Delta_edit -0.04 [-0.10, +0.01]. P6 Delta_TRIM -0.05 [-0.12, +0.01].
FALSIFIER. F-RL fires iff RL1 reads NOT-SHOWN with the 95% upper bound of f - r < 0.02: on content-closed matches with a key reference, order adds no flips beyond test-retest noise. It overturns the reading carried from POSITION-DECOMP / POSITION-FULL ([P-FAM]) that position is a material share of verdict instability for these judges on this recipe; LENGTH-PENALISED would overturn the "+0.39/1k length pays" reading for neutral filler.
WHAT A NULL MEANS FOR THE POST. RL1 NOT-SHOWN: the post's number is the noise floor r ("a small noise floor is a reusable number either way"); RL2 NEITHER: the length chapter reports the interval and the edit effect, no "length pays" headline.
WHAT THIS RESULT WILL NOT SHOW. Effects under a reasoning-text reference or no reference; other judges or recipes (never joined); that length bias is absent (RL2 is descriptive-only by support); the size of the [P-FAM] effects; free-form or agentic tasks; any rubric effect.
CLOSED-LINE CHECK AND PRIOR RESULTS. As the registrar's record above (both orders, TIE on flip, temperature omitted; not ORDER-1 / SELECTIVE-ORDER / TEMP-0). Ledger grep at e83b59d5: JUDGE-RETEST-LENGTH 0 rows. Prior results touched (results/ first): POSITION-DECOMP, POSITION-FULL, DECOMP (done; [P-FAM] history), TRACE-TRUNCATION (done; edit sensitivity, the TRIM operation), JUDGE-KEY-DOSE (registered; call path, reference form). None bracketed.
COST AND CONSEQUENCE. Run R 4,800 judge calls (2,400 judgements); run L 7,200 judge calls + <= 1,800 paraphrase calls (3,600 judgements); each under 4,000 matches and under the day cap, on separate posting days; priced by the cost-estimator before each go; engine-coder about 6 h; READY review, transport preflight, pilot 12, runs, post-run review, registrar. INSTRUMENT. tools/analysis/adaptive_profile.py, TO BE BUILT; selftest on synthetic planted profiles; mutants run in a sandbox. MODEL. P(m correct on i) = logistic(theta_m + delta_{m,v(i)} - b_i), with b_i from the LOMO Rasch fit (prior N(0, 2^2)). theta_m is m's global ability from its TRAIN answers with b fixed. delta_{m,v} is the path sum of node offsets: each node offset is d_{m,u} = estimate relative to its parent, with an empirical-Bayes prior N(0, tau_l^2) per depth l (tau_l^2 by method of moments over all models and nodes at depth l on TRAIN, floored at 0). Its posterior mean and SE come from a Laplace (one Newton step from the parent's value) fit of m's TRAIN answers in u with the parent's linear predictor as an offset. ADAPTIVE RULE (pre-registered): start at the item's benchmark node (depth 1 under the union root). Descend into the child c on the item's filing path ONLY IF (i) the posterior SE of d_{m,c} < s_max = 0.20 logit AND (ii) d_{m,c} is certified, meaning its two-sided p from z = d_{m,c} / SE is rejected by Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 within the family of m's siblings of c with a defined SE (single-sibling threshold |z| > 1.96). Otherwise stop and use the parent. The item is predicted at the node where the descent stops. SENSITIVITY GRID (DESCRIPTIVE, never deciding): s_max in {0.15, 0.20, 0.30, infinity} x q in {0.10, 0.05, 0.01, none (no certification)}. ARMS (all with the same b_i and theta_m): A adaptive AF-U. B global ability only (Rasch). C benchmark-level: one shrunk offset per (model, benchmark). D_d fixed depth d = 1..max on AF-U (d = 1 is C), path-shrunk with the same tau_l, no certification; d* = argmin GATE Brier (ties to the shallower). E AF-U leaves, unshrunk (MLE offsets, clipped at +/-5 logit). F_flat: per-benchmark spherical k-means on TRAIN at AF-U's per-source filing-leaf counts (seeds 0-4), one shrunk offset per (model, cell) toward the benchmark level; items filed to the nearest cell of their own benchmark. F_bis: per-benchmark bisecting spherical k-means hierarchy (binary, seeds 0-4) down to the same per-source leaf count, under rule A. Filing asymmetry: A files flatLeaf over all leaves (UNION-AF-ROUTE D-4, 191 cross-source EVAL items), while F files within the benchmark. The own-source-filed subset is reported beside every contrast (DESCRIPTIVE). INTERVAL: two-stage bootstrap, B 2,000, default_rng(20261008): CK-CLOSE components of EVAL resampled, then k-means seeds resampled for F arms. 95% (and 90% for TOST) percentile intervals; the bootstrap SD is the SE reported. Scores: Brier (DECIDING) and log-loss (beside), averaged over the 18 x EVAL (model, item) cells.
READOUTS AND CRITERIA (Brier, lower is better; D_X = Brier(X) - Brier(A), so positive = A better; clauses evaluated in the order written, FIRST that holds is the word; exhaustive and exclusive; the minimal meaningful effect delta_min = 0.0005 Brier is fixed now). AP1 (DECIDING; D_C; the POINT and the 95% INTERVAL both decide, as written, in ONE clause each): GRANULARITY-PAYS (HELD) iff LB95(D_C) > 0 AND the point D_C >= 0.0005. TOO-SMALL (FAILED) iff UB95(D_C) < 0.0005. UNDETERMINED otherwise. FAILS (rule 8): at the planned n, GRANULARITY-PAYS is refuted by LB95 <= 0 or a point < 0.0005. AP2 (SECONDARY, scored; D_{d*}): ADAPTIVE-BETTER iff LB95 > 0; FIXED-BETTER iff UB95 < 0; PARITY iff the 90% interval lies inside [-0.0005, +0.0005] (TOST); NEITHER otherwise. AP3 (SECONDARY, scored; D_{F_bis}, hierarchy vs hierarchy under the same rule) and AP4 (SECONDARY, scored; D_{F_flat}): TREE-BETTER iff LB95 > 0; KMEANS-BETTER iff UB95 < 0; PARITY iff the 90% interval lies inside +/-0.0005; NEITHER otherwise. Each FAILS by the opposite sign word or an interval leaving the band. AP3 / AP4 are CONFIRMATORY OF A SEEN PATTERN (RESP-PROFILE-INFO RP2 K0-BETTER). DESCRIPTIVE: B, E, every D_d (the depth curve on GATE and EVAL), log-loss for every contrast, the adaptive-depth histogram (the share of (model, item) predictions served below the benchmark level), per-source contrasts, the own-source subset, the sensitivity grid, and the af_clean_s42 leg (A vs B, A vs D_{d*}; MMLU-Pro only). FINGERPRINTS (DESCRIPTIVE, for the blog visual): per model, the AF-U nodes certified strong or weak (sign of d_{m,u}, BH q 0.05 within sibling families, TRAIN fit), with the node's member count and EVAL calibration beside. A fingerprint is not a published capability claim. Every word is reachable at infinite budget. As n -> infinity every true nonzero offset is certified and every SE falls below s_max, so A reaches the leaves. GRANULARITY-PAYS is not guaranteed by construction: if no child is certified, A coincides with C and D_C = 0 exactly (TOO-SMALL). The adaptive-depth histogram is printed so that this degenerate case is visible. At the planned TRAIN n (about 96 items per leaf), SE(d) about 1 / sqrt(0.22 x 96) = 0.22 > s_max at a typical leaf. The rule therefore stops above most leaves BY DESIGN (s_max 0.20 needs about 114 items per node per model), in line with the recorded ~210-item reliability crossing. TOO-SMALL is a substantive outcome, because the true gain can be below delta_min at any budget. RULING P-1 (GAP-FIX-CC; option (b), a registered seed-replacement rule). A V seed that is B6-VOID (a one-member cell, mean resultant length 1) on a tree is replaced IN ITS SLOT by the lowest seed not yet used on that tree, ascending from 5 (5, 6, ..., 9); the replacement is deterministic, label-free and printed ('<tree> V<j>: seed s B6-VOID -> seed t OK'). The rule binds every tree and every seed of both legs (today it changes only Q_e1sd2 V0: seed 0 -> seed 5 if seed 5 fits; Q_e1sd2 V1-V4 stay seeds 1-4; the other 34 fits are unchanged). If seeds 5-9 are all VOID for a slot, that tree is printed VOID-TREE and drops out under the registered words (GF1-CC still the word on '>= 2 of the GAP-SHOWN qwen3 trees'; NOT EVALUABLE if fewer than 2). WHY (b): it keeps the registration's meaning (three deciding trees, five V fits per tree at the tree's own k, FLAT-MIX-MMLU's fitter UNCHANGED, V0 the M1 comparator) with no researcher choice: the VOID is a property of one k-means++ draw (an isolated point drawn as a centre, nn cosine 0.4605; review row 3), not of the mixture; seeds are exchangeable; the next seed is fixed by rule, not picked, and no label-bearing number exists on any seed. (a) is rejected because it turns the deciding '>= 2 of 3' into '2 of 2' on one tree's initialisation and raises NOT EVALUABLE by construction; (c) is rejected because it changes the instrument the registration calls unchanged (a new registration, more freedom). Bracket appended to the DATA OBJECTS AND HYGIENE line of GAP-FIX-CC's registration (L25033). BUILDER DELTA OWED: the rule; P-2 (--dry-run fits V0-V4 on the real fit sets, label-free, and prints per tree/slot converged / iters / B6 OK | VOID | REPLACED); P-3 (the tree named in any refusal); a mutant that replaces by any seed other than the next unused one must die. Then a delta READY review; no --run before it.

WIN-MAP tests the SCORED EVAL set (the 5,907 key-read, structurally complete items of UNION-AF-ROUTE) and finds 0 twins there (12f42190 row 8; 7e2673d4 row 7): a twin v2 item joins a RES and a GEN question_id under one stem, so n_q >= 2 and it is not a scored item. QUESTION AND KIND. Zero-call CPU readout for post 3 ("The harness picks the winner"). On MATH, the stored scorer (X0) and MATH-FIX disagree on 5,181 of 23,832 rows, and every one of them is X0 0 / MATH-FIX 1. The questions are three: do the documented scorers reorder the models, how far does each model's accuracy shift, and which kinds of disagreement drive the shifts? IFEval is the blind leg: its strict and loose scorers have not been compared on this roster.

H, THE SENSITIVITY LINE (definition pinned; reported beside; decides nothing). H(row) = 1 iff the official verdict is 1, OR a stated answer matches the reference. The region is the text after the last </think>; a response with an unclosed <think> delivers nothing. The stated answers are tried in this order: the boxed and Minerva-sentence ("final") candidates of labelled(region), then the answer line (the last match of (final answer|the answer is|answer[:*]) in the last 2 non-empty lines, taking its last $...$ or else the text after the last "is" / ":"). The first candidate that matches credits the row. A candidate matches if math_fix's modes(c, ref) is str, paren or num, or if it is a numeric prefix whose remainder is unit-only (unit_prefix_ok). Corrected references apply to H ONLY; the official scorer and MATH-FIX keep the stored ones: 2060002 -> 20x+23y+26z-69=0; 2060129 -> 11x+6y+5z+86=0; 2000164 -> 4x-5y=-50 (54 rows; matched as equations after whitespace removal and 1x -> x).
